fahnuir@student (Pedro Miguel Valerio Ramos) writes:
>What am I supposed to do when after the votes are called, the voting ends
>up beeing a tie ??

In Jyhad, the rules explained that tied votes fail.
In VtES, this was omitted from the rules.

Tied votes still fail, however:
